title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 18
text:
Line Size
Each insurer has their own share 
(line size), but for CAT modelling we 
always assume 100% line.
Normally the line is entered in the 
PARTOF column, but for modelling 
it should be shifted to BLANLIMAT.
Enter ‘1’ in the BLANLIMAT column 
for every row (means 100% line).
BLANLIMAMT
